ros.protocol: Two warmups then ten alternating-order pairs. One or two separate endpoints, serial per-device acquisition-free construction and publish/drop. Identical existing input records; dynamic metadata cached. Named dynamic field filling modeled on production publisher. Typed uses generated RMW-native structs with owned C sequences. Component timers are per trial; total medians derived from each trial sum. No native subscriber latency or delivery timing. Encoder control averages 100 calls for one packet, independent of sensor count. Shared workstation, no CPU pinning. Native field validation runs separately with reliable DDS and rclpy. No runtime publisher change. Endpoint subscription counts are checked before and after every case.
ros.validation: Exact typed/dynamic generated-struct equality for all measured sizes; native subscriber fields verified at 0/1/2/20000/3/0/1 transitions, including singleton typed delivery.

mujoco.protocol: Two warmups, eight alternating pairs; twenty calls per timing. Query-only, includes owned output copies in both paths. New coherent blocker snapshot each pair; no physics stepping. Scalar and batch share origins; exact-origin accuracy checked separately. No GPU or ROS.
